transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It’s my right knee — it’s been aching and getting worse, and it’s stopping me doing the things I normally do.

Could you tell me when you first noticed the ache in your right knee, whether it came on suddenly or gradually, and if anything seemed to set it off — and also whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It came on gradually a while back, and going down stairs or walking a fair way seems to make it worse. Yes, one of the antibiotics gives me a rash.
How much does the aching in your right knee get in the way of your usual daily activities?
Quite a bit now — it’s making ordinary things harder, and I can’t manage some of my usual walks anymore.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly at the moment, and what dose if you know it?
I take some tablets for my diabetes, blood pressure and cholesterol, plus a daily aspirin. I’m not sure about the doses — just the usual ones, I think.
How bad is the aching in your knee these days?
It’s pretty bad on some days — enough to make me stop and rest. I couldn’t put a number on it.
Can you tell me about any operations you’ve had in the past?
I had a stent put in a heart artery a while back. Nothing else that I can think of.
Besides the aching in your knee, has anything else been going on with it?
It sometimes swells a bit by the evening, but I haven’t noticed any redness, fever, or the knee locking up.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed since the knee aching started, such as changes in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy?
No, I haven’t noticed any changes in appetite, sleep, weight, or energy.
What worries you most about your knee at the moment?
I’d like something stronger for the pain, and I keep wondering whether I might end up needing a knee replacement.
Do you have any allergies, or have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
Yes — penicillin gives me a rash.
When did the aching in your right knee first start — did it come on suddenly, build up gradually over time, or are you not sure?
It’s been coming and going for about three years, but it’s got noticeably worse over the last two months or so.
Since your knee trouble started, have you noticed any changes in your bladder or bowel habits, or in your breathing?
No, I haven’t noticed anything different with my bladder or bowels, and my breathing has been fine.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly or have taken recently, including anything new or changed, and the dose if you know it?
I take metformin 1 g twice a day, aspirin 75 mg once a day, atorvastatin 40 mg at night, and ramipril 5 mg once a day. Nothing new or changed recently.
Besides the medicines you’ve listed, is there anything else you take for your heart or the stent in your heart artery, even if it’s only now and then?
No, I don’t take anything else for my heart or the stent, even now and then.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
